news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. Of these new board members, 2 were independent directors. The company's board is composed of: 5 new directors. No experienced directors. 1 highly experienced director. 2 independent directors (4 non-independent directors). Chairman Suraj Zanwar is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2003. Independent Non-Executive Director Manish Goswami was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2026. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Minority of independent directors. Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.

news.title: First half 2026 earnings released: ₹2.13 loss per share (vs ₹7.30 loss in 1H 2025)
news.body: First half 2026 results: ₹2.13 loss per share (improved from ₹7.30 loss in 1H 2025). Revenue: ₹113.2m (down 40% from 1H 2025). Net loss: ₹53.2m (loss narrowed 71% from 1H 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 56 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: Cian Healthcare Limited Announces Appointment of Pradeep Kumar Jain, Rajesh Jain, Manish Goswami, and Anjani Misra as Directors, Effective January 9, 2026
news.body: Cian Healthcare Limited announced the appointment of Mr. Pradeep Kumar Jain as Promoter and Non-Executive Director, Mr. Rajesh Jain as Promoter and Non-Executive Director, Mr. Manish Goswami as Independent Non-Executive Director, and Mr. Anjani Misra as Independent Non-Executive Director, effective January 9, 2026, as approved by the Implementation Committee in compliance with the NCLT Order dated December 18, 2025. Mr. Pradeep Kumar Jain is a highly esteemed professional in the pharmaceutical industry, boasting over 25 years of experience. His journey began as a pharmaceutical trader in Ukraine and culminated in a leadership role at the Ananta Medicare Group. news.title: New minor risk - Revenue size
news.body: The company makes less than US$5m in revenue. Total revenue: ₹309m (US$3.5m) This is considered a minor risk. Companies with a small amount of revenue are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook.
